summary: 本节课介绍了如何通过面试获得offer，包括英语自我介绍、简历准备、面试技巧和离职原因等要点。
keypoints: 英语自我介绍要简洁明了，控制在1-2分钟内。
准备3-5份简历副本，确保熟悉内容。
面试前准备应对实际业务问题，如价格、资料、交期等。
强调团队合作精神，思考自己在团队中的角色和改进点。
离职原因要规范，突出公司能提供的优势和发展机会。
面试成功率达80%后，获得offer的机会增加。

sections.heading: 英语自我介绍的重要性
sections.content: 英语自我介绍是面试必备环节，需简洁明了，避免使用艰深词汇，控制在1-2分钟内。可参考提供的模板进行准备。

sections.heading: 简历准备与注意事项
sections.content: 面试前准备3-5份简历副本，确保熟悉内容。针对简历上的问题进行准备，避免出现错误。

sections.heading: 面试技巧
sections.content: 准备应对实际业务问题，如价格、资料、交期等。强调团队合作精神，思考自己在团队中的角色和改进点。

sections.heading: 离职原因的处理
sections.content: 离职原因要规范，突出公司能提供的优势和发展机会，避免过多提及前公司。

sections.heading: 面试成功后的应对
sections.content: 面试成功率达80%后，获得offer的机会增加。如HR提出新薪酬预期，成功几率更高。

sections.heading: 总结与分享
sections.content: 分享面试经验和个人技巧，欢迎留言交流。

title: 1.3 菜鸟C教你拿offer 2
readable:
大家好，我是阿坑。这一节课由小溪为大家讲解如何拿到offer。上一节课我们介绍了如何通过招聘平台、邮件、电话和扫楼等方式获得面试机会。这一节课我们将重点探讨如何在获得面试机会后，通过面试拿到offer。这是一个非常重要的技巧。在面试前，首先需要准备的是英语自我介绍。英语是必备的技能，所有面试都会有一项英语自我介绍环节。因此，在准备英语自我介绍时，必须认真准备。以前小凯认为英语自我介绍越长越好，甚至加入一些不熟悉的词汇，以为这样显得自己很高尚。实际上这种方法是错误的。因为面试官一天要面试很多人，最多10个，如果自我介绍太长，会让他们感到疲惫。所以，自我介绍最好控制在1到2分钟，简洁易懂，便于灵活运用。以下是一个英语自我介绍的小模板供大家参考：

I would like to give a brief introduction of myself for you. I am an English graduate from a certain university. In the past few years, I worked at a certain place. During my work, in the past six months, I worked at a certain company. In my work, I was mainly responsible for what. In the process of my work, I achieved some results. All these experiences have made me more connected to these working experiences and achievements, which have made me more flexible and rational. How to show my flexibility and rationality? The clients and colleagues from other departments get along with me very well. I think these flexible and open-minded, willing-to-help personalities will make me fit for this position. This introduction is relatively short because I only had half a year of work experience when I prepared this introduction, so I directly copied it. It is mainly for everyone to refer to. You can see that the introduction is very clear. First, I will make a simple introduction, then I am a graduate student, where is the graduate student, what work did I do in the past few months. In fact, this can also be applied to the key points we discussed in the last class, such as developing international markets, developing new suppliers, doing cost breakdown, cost control, and teamwork spirit, etc. Then, what are the achievements of these work experiences that make me become what I am? Also, take a simple sentence to introduce it, and then make a very simple summary, that is, my experience and summary make me very suitable for this position because I belong to the procurement work. But if you are in business, there are also many highlights. For example, if you have done a big customer this year, and the business volume is about 10 million US dollars, this is a very prominent point, you can write it in your self-introduction. Then, in charge of overseas markets, during this process, I achieved a certain performance, achieved a performance of 10 million US dollars, and developed some customers, such as some well-known brands, Walmart, Kma, CS, etc., which you can put in. The basic content does not change, but the content can be more rich. Do not use too many difficult words because we are Chinese, in standard English there may also be some errors in spoken language, and even if your English is very good, the HR's English is not very good. What should we do? Then, when you understand and they do not understand, it is also embarrassing. Therefore, we should use some simple, easy to understand, and can express the meaning of the English subtitle introduction is more grade. The time is mentioned again, control within 1 to 2 minutes is enough.

After the English self-introduction is finished, the HR will make some detailed inquiries based on your explanation. In the next lesson, we will talk about how to adjust the resume according to different companies and different situations. If you are interviewing this company, and the interviewer asks you about your previous company, you should not repeat the same thing. This may lead to some problems. Another point is that before you go for the interview, print out 3 to 5 copies of your resume. Although many companies will print out your online resume when you go for the interview, there is a chance that they will not have it. So you should prepare it in your file. And pay attention to some small details, do not make mistakes. The questions on the resume are the content you wrote. As long as you are familiar with your resume and slightly enrich it, there should be few problems. More questions in the interview may be about actual business issues, such as your business capabilities. You just said that your business has reached 10 million US dollars, and you have cooperated with these customers. What are the important skills for developing these large customers? What are the problems that must be paid attention to? This requires you to be fully prepared. The second point is that many businesses need to deal with many problems, such as delivery time, data, and various price issues. How do you deal with these problems? For example, if the price is too high, how will you cooperate with the customer to reduce the price? And if the data has a problem, how will you deal with these problems in the factory? How to comfort the customer's emotions? Finally, if the delivery time is delayed, maybe some say it is impossible to delay, you must delay it, how will you tell the customer about this matter? Will you use other expansion methods to solve the problem of expansion delay? And what methods will you use to persuade the customer that your company is young and energetic? The third point is that many companies will emphasize teamwork spirit. Maybe before you were in a factory with only one business, you were not very clear about how to write these team problems. But when you go to a big company or a big platform, the problem of teamwork will be included in the consideration. So before this question is raised, you should think about what you are not good at in teamwork, or what defects need to be supplemented and improved. Before the interview, you should think about it well. The first is the reason for the transfer, which is actually a very embarrassing question. When I was working for the first job, the reason for the transfer was very simple because the previous factory did not provide social security, and the company I am working for now can definitely meet this requirement, so the reason for my transfer is very simple. About the standard reason for leaving, I have summarized it myself. The main reason for leaving can be that the previous factory cannot provide what you can get from the current company, such as the social security I mentioned earlier, or some business opportunities such as the opportunity to participate in international exhibitions. The main reason for leaving can be for development. Do not talk too much about the previous factory.

在面试中，更多地要思考为什么你想加入这家公司，这家公司能为你提供什么样的预期，这是公司肯定能给予的。当这些问题都问完之后，如果面试官对你表示出兴趣并愿意与你进一步讨论，那么你获得offer的成功率已经达到了80%。因为如果他对你不感兴趣，也不想要你，那么在问完这些问题后，他几乎就会告诉你，你的情况他大概了解了，并感谢你参加面试。如果到了下一步面试，我会通过电话或通知你。但如果你的面试官直接拒绝了你，不愿意讨论你的期望，那么你拿到这个offer的几率就可以上升到80%，我也可以恭喜你了。关于小熙的offer，其实大家已经知道了很多问题，我也只是在这里分享一些自己的经验和一些小技巧，希望大家能在这里留言给我，分享更好的方法或更适用的技巧。谢谢大家。
